name: ATL File Commander
shortDescription: Modern dual-pane Android file manager with cloud integration, archive extractor, and storage cleaner.
fullDescription:
ATL File Commander is the ultimate file management suite for Android power users and everyday enthusiasts. Designed from the ground up for speed, elegance, and extreme privacy.

Key Highlights:
• Dual-pane view for effortless file drag and drop.
• Root explorer mode with full read/write partition access.
• Built-in compression tool for ZIP, RAR, 7Z, and TAR archives.
• Direct Wi-Fi transfer between phone, PC, and TV without cables.
• Secure encrypted vault with biometric fingerprint authentication.
• Zero intrusive ads and zero trackers.
changelog:
• Optimized for Android 15 & 16 preview
• Added fast background batch extraction
• Enhanced Wi-Fi Direct file transfer speed by 40%
• Fixed thumbnail cache clearing issue

name: ATL StreamCast Pro
shortDescription: Ultra-low latency media streamer with 4K HDR playback, lossless audio equalizer, and DLNA/Chromecast support.
fullDescription:
Experience audio and video entertainment like never before. ATL StreamCast Pro delivers hardware-accelerated decoding across MKV, MP4, AVI, FLAC, and WebM codecs with zero stutter.

Features:
• 10-band studio parametric audio equalizer with bass booster.
• Picture-in-Picture floating video player for multitasking.
• Subtitle auto-sync with OpenSubtitles API integration.
• Background playback with screen off for audiobooks and music.
• Cast smoothly to Android TV, Apple TV, FireStick, and Smart TVs.
changelog:
• Added AV1 hardware acceleration codec
• New dark OLED pure black theme
• Improved gesture volume and brightness controls

name: ATL Speed Engine 3D
shortDescription: High-octane cyberpunk arcade racer featuring 120 FPS physics, customizable supercars, and offline career mode.
fullDescription:
Feel the rush of neon city tracks at blistering speeds! ATL Speed Engine 3D brings console-grade graphics directly to your Android device.

Game Features:
• Full Vulkan API optimization for smooth 60/90/120 FPS rendering.
• 18 customizable aerodynamic hypercars with realistic engine acoustics.
• 12 neon-lit futuristic city and canyon tracks.
• Complete offline campaign - no internet required.
• Controller support for Xbox, PlayStation, and Razer Kishi.
changelog:
• Added 2 new cyberpunk hypercars
• Upgraded vehicle physics and drift mechanics
• Reduced memory usage on mid-range chipsets

name: ATL Secure Vault & Notes
shortDescription: Zero-knowledge AES-256 encrypted notepad, password manager, and document safe with biometric unlock.
fullDescription:
Your private thoughts, credentials, and confidential documents belong solely to you. ATL Secure Vault protects your critical data with local military-grade encryption.

Key Capabilities:
• End-to-end client-side AES-256 GCM encryption.
• Biometric face & fingerprint unlock.
• Self-destruct PIN trigger for emergency duress situations.
• Markdown formatting, checklist tasks, and image attachments.
• Encrypted backup and restore to local storage.
changelog:
• Added auto-lock on app switch
• Support for rich markdown checklists
• Enhanced password generator with entropy indicator

name: ATL Battery & RAM Optimizer
shortDescription: Real-time CPU thermal monitor, background task suspension, junk cache remover, and battery lifespan extender.
fullDescription:
Keep your Android device operating as snappy as the first day you unboxed it. ATL Optimizer analyzes background processes and eliminates lingering ghost caches safely without touching personal user data.

Features:
• CPU temperature and throttle monitor with live graph.
• One-touch dormant background process hibernation.
• App cache cleaner with selective whitelist.
• Battery health degradation estimator and charge limiter.
• Lightweight footprint (< 15MB) with negligible battery consumption.
changelog:
• Added Android 15 process grouping
• New ambient charging animation
• Reduced CPU monitoring poll overhead to < 0.2%
